string.name: name
string.value: Character Name Change

string.name: desc
string.value: This scroll will enable you to change your character name to something totally new! Please be aware that the character must be at level 10 or higher to be eligible for the name change and the new name should be an acceptable new name that has passed the name check. The name-change will occur during the following server check, and you will then be restricted from changing names for one month.

string.name: name
string.value: Character Transfer

string.name: desc
string.value: This item is used to transfer your character from one game world to another. Your character must be at least Level 50, and only up to 100,000,000 mesos will be transferred with the character.

string.name: name
string.value: Maple Life (A-Type)

string.name: desc
string.value:
#c*Warning: If you do not have an empty Character slot, it cannot be used.#

If you are over #cLevel 30#, a new Level 30 character can be created in your world.You can choose one of the following classes #c(Warrior, Magician, Thief, Bowman and Pirate)# at #c1st Job status#.

Only the amount of AP needed for each respective 1st jobs have been allocated and the rest of AP and SP can be distributed to your liking.#cBasic equips and items# needed for travel are also provided.

string.name: name
string.value: Parallel Coupon

string.name: desc
string.value:
Allows you to create a Lv. 10 character in the same world.
#cEquipment items (Equip item, Use item, and Mesos) will be copied over.#
#cCannot be purchased without an empty character slot.#
#cCannot be purchased by a character below Level 13.#

string.name: name
string.value: Character Card (Lv. 50)

string.name: desc
string.value:
Allows you to create a character of any currently available class, with the exception of Cygnus Knights.
Allows you to create a character with an item that will level the character up to Lv. 50 (Cygnus Knights excluded)
Can only be purchased using a character that's Lv. 50 or higher, and there must be a free character slot. After purchase, a character with an item that can level it up to Lv. 50 is created in the world where the purchase was made.
On the character screen, you will see a transparent character with the "Click" sign.
#cBe careful when using the level-up item, as SP (Skill Point) cannot be obtained if you do not do the job advancements.#

string.name: name
string.value: Maple Life (B-Type)

string.name: desc
string.value:
#c*Warning : If all 12 character slots are full, it cannot be used.#

This package has the #cMaple Life item plus an Extra Character Slot coupon.#Using this item will automiatically create a new slot.

If you are over #cLevel 30#, a new Level 30 character can be created in your world. You can choose one of the following classes #c(Warrior, Magician, Thief, Bowman and Pirate)# at #c1st Job status.#

Only the amount of AP needed for each respective 1st jobs have been allocated and the rest of AP and SP can be distributed to your liking.#cBasic equips and items# needed for travel are also provided.

string.name: name
string.value: Miu Miu the Traveling Merchant

string.name: desc
string.value: Use this to experience the same effect as entering a general store. Can purchase potions to recover HP & MP, throwing stars, and recharge bullets. Some maps restrict the use of this item, though.

string.name: name
string.value: Miu Miu the Rookie Traveling Merchant

string.name: desc
string.value: Use this to access a general store from anywhere. You can purchase potions to recover HP & MP, throwing stars, and recharge bullets. Some maps restrict the use of this item, though.

string.name: name
string.value: [30 Day] Miu Miu the Merchant

string.name: desc
string.value: Use this to access a #cGeneral Store# from anywhere. You can purchase potions to recover HP & MP, recharge throwing stars and bullets, and more.\n#cUnlimited use# for 30 days.

string.name: name
string.value: [30 Day] Mr. Wang's Portable Storage

string.name: desc
string.value: Use this to access the #Storage Keeper# from almost anywhere. You can then move most items into or out of storage.\nCan be used #cwithout restriction# for 30 days.
